title: Accidental fertilizer poisoning at a flower show
setting: Garden centre flower show. Contestant accidentally swallowed liquid fertilizer instead of tea. Panicked, nauseous, severe abdominal pain.
verdictExplanation: Accidental chemical ingestion with severe pain, nausea, panic, compromised airway, and borderline low BP (73/51). Sick: 999.

shared.airway: They may have a slight burn in their airway from the poison
shared.circulation: Pale and sweaty, weak rapid pulse

history.history: Swallowed liquid fertilizer instead of tea 10 minutes ago

followUp.question: What is the most concerning clinical sign in this patient that suggests systemic toxicity rather than just a localized burn?

options.text: The borderline low blood pressure (73/51) combined with constricted pupils and hypoxia
The patient's high pain score of 7/10
The rapid pulse rate of 110 bpm
The patient's panicked breathing and alertness

followUp.explanation: While pain and a rapid pulse can be driven by panic, the combination of hypotension, constricted pupils, and hypoxia (SpO2 87%) are major red flags pointing to severe systemic poisoning (such as organophosphates in the fertilizer).

levelFlags.cfaNotes: Call 999 immediately. Identify chemical, rinse mouth, do not induce vomiting.
levelFlags.erNotes: Suspected organophosphate ingestion. Assess airway for swelling/secretions. Administer high-flow oxygen immediately for low SpO2. Keep warm, check BGL, and prepare for rapid transfer.
